response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, avg_per_day_price, avg_per_day_price / AVG(avg_per_day_price) OVER () AS ratio_to_mean_of_ratings FROM r

assumptions.assumption: The ratio's denominator is the unweighted mean of the five per-rating average per-day prices (each rating counted once), computed with a window function over the per-rating rows. This is what the request states, so it is not an open choice.
All films are included. rental_duration is never zero (the verified values run from 3 to 7), so the division is safe. Multiplying by 1.0 avoids integer division.
